profile: standalone microkernel specs with microtest rootserver
observations: The old atomic lock failed the deterministic foreign-owner release regression before the fix. Owner-checked release now preserves foreign ownership, and the no-thread syscall backedge retains its reacquired BKL until the next single release.

All native kernel specs passed, including existing SMP quiescence and translation-retirement contracts. The new fixture maps and unmaps an exactly owned frame in a separate owned VSpace, generating ordinary retirement IPIs; it does not inject a test-only interrupt or write the observation counter.

The counter is incremented only by the actual no-thread syscall idle backedge, after asserting current CPU ownership. A positive same-run count proves target branch execution; the bounded userspace pauses make no elapsed-time assertion.

Independent source review cleared compressed paging ABI, retained exact capabilities and leaf-first cleanup. The fixture and observation are spec-only. This is microkernel correctness evidence, not strict NT font cleanup, desktop rendering or a measured NT performance improvement.
